description: Merge, extract and rotate PDFs; resize images; convert CSV and format JSON with FileStation.

defaultPrompt: Merge these PDFs in the order I upload them.
Convert this CSV to JSON without changing its values.
interface.longDescription: Process supplied files with bundled Python scripts: merge PDFs, extract or rotate pages, extract selectable text, resize and convert images, convert CSV to JSON and format JSON. Includes a guide to 50 FileStation website tools. Runs in the host execution environment without FileStation login, network uploads or account syncing. Requires Python and supported libraries; availability depends on the host.

name: filestation
